summary_md: **[@aiproduck](https://x.com/aiproduck/status/2115610820055089611)** describes **Orca**, an MIT desktop app that runs coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode…) side by side, each in its own git worktree: fan one prompt to several agents, compare, and merge the best. It also offers a mobile companion and SSH worktrees; the poster notes anonymous usage data is collected (opt-out).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - stablyai/orca: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

relevance: Worktree-per-agent fan-out is a practical harness pattern for best-of-N agentic coding.
